notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two leaves of the upper wall cabinet are reported separately because they are manipulated consecutively; their closing actions occur close together between frames 544 and 560, making the exact individual off times less certain.
scene_description: A user surveys a narrow modern kitchen, then opens and closes a food-storage drawer, separately opens and closes two wall-cabinet doors above the stove, and finally opens and closes a utensil-and-wrap drawer on the opposite side of the stove.
